stem:
Zayne sorted some figures into two groups.

Group X

Group Y

Which statement about the figures Zayne sorted is true?

options.label: F
options.text: All the figures in Group X are cylinders.

options.label: G
options.text: All the figures in Group X are cones.

options.label: H
options.text: All the figures in Group Y are prisms.

options.label: J
options.text: All the figures in Group Y are rectangular prisms.

visual_elements: Image of Group X containing a cone, a cylinder, and a sphere
Image of Group Y containing a cube, a triangular prism, and a rectangular prism
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires recognizing and classifying different 3D shapes and their categories (cones, cylinders, prisms), which involves modest reasoning about geometric properties.
